info.short_name: Median ED length of stay: all ED
info.long_name: Median emergency department length of stay for all ED encounters
info.short_description: Median time in minutes from ED arrival to ED departure for all ED encounters.
info.long_description: Median emergency department length of stay in minutes for all ED encounters. Encounters are Epic Cosmos ED encounters with a United States country of residence, attributed to the patient's state of residence and to the calendar quarter of arrival, and assigned to the all ED group of the ED Diagnoses grouper. Length of stay runs from arrival to ED departure, so it includes boarding time for patients awaiting an inpatient or psychiatric bed. Cells built on 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source. In these cases, length of stay is left missing and the suppression flag is 1. The 'all' variant is the Total group of the ED Diagnoses grouper: every ED encounter, including diagnoses not shown as their own group, and not a total of the other variants. The 'other' variant is the grouper's Other group: ED encounters for other mental health reasons.
info.statement: In {location}, the median all ED ED encounter lasted {value} minutes.

info.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the all ED median ED length of stay (the cell was built on 10 or fewer encounters) and the value is left missing; 0 when a value was published.

The grouper's groups are not guaranteed to be mutually exclusive, and the age bands do not add up to 'Overall'. Divide by epic_ed_n_visits for the share of all ED encounters; imputed cells make small shares approximate.
epic_ed_n_visits_suicidal_behavior.statement: In {location}, there were {value} ED visits for suicidal behavior.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. ICD-10 codes for mental health diagnoses were obtained from paper Zima BT, Gay JC, Rodean J, et al. Classification System for International Classification of Diseases, Ninth Revision, Clinical Modification and Tenth Revision Pediatric Mental Health Disorders. JAMA Pediatr. 2020;174(6):620–622. doi:10.1001/jamapediatrics.2020.0037
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
